pages.text: $(italic)More Red$() begins with the $(bold)Red Alloy Ingot$() (smelt redstone with iron) and the $(bold)Red Alloy Wire$() you draw from it.$(br2)The wire is flat like dust but carries $(bold)much further$() before fading, and runs up walls and across ceilings — the compact backbone of a tidy build.
pages.title: Red Alloy Wire

pages.text: Lay it with a $(bold)Redwire Spool$() to string long runs quickly. Where dust would need repeater after repeater, alloy wire just keeps going.
pages.title: The Spool
